segments.thig13.2:1.1: “‘Samaṇā’ti bhoti supi [bhoti tvaṃ sayasi (sī.), bhoti maṃ vipassi (syā.)],‘samaṇā’ti pabujjhasi [paṭibujjhasi (sī. syā.)];
segments.thig13.2:1.3: Samaṇāneva [samaṇānameva (sī. syā.)] kittesi, samaṇī nūna [samaṇī nu (ka.)] bhavissasi.
segments.thig13.2:2.3: Rohinī dāni pucchāmi, kena te samaṇā piyā.
segments.thig13.2:3.3: Āsaṃsukā sādukāmā, kena te samaṇā piyā”.
segments.thig13.2:5.3: Rāgaṃ dosaṃ pajahanti, tena me samaṇā piyā.
segments.thig13.2:6.3: Sabbaṃ pāpaṃ pahīnesaṃ, tena me samaṇā piyā.
segments.thig13.2:7.3: Manokammaṃ suci nesaṃ, tena me samaṇā piyā.
segments.thig13.2:8.3: Puṇṇā sukkāna dhammānaṃ [sukkehi dhammehi (sī. syā. aṭṭha.)], tena me samaṇā piyā.
segments.thig13.2:9.3: Atthaṃ dhammañca desenti, tena me samaṇā piyā.
segments.thig13.2:10.3: Ekaggacittā satimanto, tena me samaṇā piyā.
segments.thig13.2:11.3: Dukkhassantaṃ pajānanti, tena me samaṇā piyā.
segments.thig13.2:12.3: Anapekkhāva gacchanti, tena me samaṇā piyā.
segments.thig13.2:13.1: “Na tesaṃ koṭṭhe openti, na kumbhiṃ na khaḷopiyaṃ;
segments.thig13.2:14.1: “Na te hiraññaṃ gaṇhanti, na suvaṇṇaṃ na rūpiyaṃ;
segments.thig13.2:14.3: Paccuppannena yāpenti, tena me samaṇā piyā.
segments.thig13.2:15.3: Aññamaññaṃ piyāyanti [pihayanti (ka.)], tena me samaṇā piyā”.
segments.thig13.2:16.1: “Atthāya vata no bhoti, kule jātāsi rohinī;
segments.thig13.2:16.3: Saddhā buddhe ca dhamme ca, saṅghe ca tibbagāravā.
segments.thig13.2:18.3: Sace bhāyasi dukkhassa, sace te dukkhamappiyaṃ.
segments.thig13.2:19.3: Samādiyāhi sīlāni, taṃ te atthāya hehiti”.
segments.thig13.2:20.3: Samādiyāmi sīlāni, taṃ me atthāya hehiti.
segments.thig13.2:21.3: Tevijjo sottiyo camhi, vedagū camhi nhātako”.

lines: Evaṃ brāhmaṇo saraṇesu sīlesu ca patiṭṭhito aparabhāge sañjātasaṃvego pabbajitvā vipassanaṃ vaḍḍhetvā arahatte patiṭṭhāya attano paṭipattiṃ paccavekkhitvā udānento “brahmabandhū”ti gāthamāha.
